correctness.rationale: All six permutation coefficients are parameterized explicitly by t; row-column identities prove reconstruction. Nonnegativity is exactly the closed interval [L,U]. Every interior coordinate is strictly positive if L<U, while each endpoint has at least one zero, proving exact minimum support and at most two minimizers. Grid endpoints have coefficients integral-linear in grid entries. The sharp Q=13 witness and 13,558 exhaustive integer matrix checks were replayed with package verifier; checks do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: Dimension three is the first dimension with nonunique Birkhoff weights. The result completely classifies minimum-cardinality decomposition for every 3-by-3 input, determines the at-most-two optimal schedules, proves the entire real-vs-fixed-precision question has no gap in this dimension, and supplies an exact constant-size optimum with a sharp five-term worst case. This is a natural exact classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice; it does not claim a solution in higher dimensions.
